capabilities: Collect Markdown tasks into a kanban board
Move tasks between tag, text, status, or priority columns
Filter, sort, and group tasks into swimlanes
Read and write Tasks plugin or Dataview metadata
Manage multiple boards from a dashboard
extras: Free and open source. Works standalone; the Tasks plugin and Dataview integrations are only needed for property-schema features. README notes its screenshots are outdated.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view tasks scattered across many files as a kanban board.

relations.evidence: Obsidian Tasks plugin: due, scheduled, start, done, created, priority, and recurrence metadata.
Dataview: due, scheduled, start, done, completion, created, priority, repeat, and arbitrary inline fields.

summary: Kanban board plugin that turns Markdown tasks from your vault into a board, writing changes back to the source files.
